title: Entra ID User Sign-in with Unusual Authentication Type
author: Elastic
description:
Identifies rare instances of authentication methods for Microsoft Entra ID principal users. An adversary with stolen
credentials may attempt to authenticate with an unusual method, which may indicate an attempt to bypass conditional
access policies (CAP) and multi-factor authentication (MFA) requirements. The authentication method may not be commonly
used by the user based on their historical sign-in activity.
